 FORECAST: Grab the shades! More sunshine today! 
 The downtown Louisville skyline (WDRB + WAVE Photo) By WDRB+WAVE Digital Staff Published : Oct. 23, 2026 at 6:15 AM EDT | Updated : 13 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google WEATHER HEADLINES 
 NEXT 12: Sunny with highs in the 70s 
 SHORT TERM: Cool/chilly once again tonight with lows in the 40s 
 LONG TERM: Dry and warm weekend in the 70s with our next chance of rain showing up toward next weekend 
 LATEST FORECAST 
 LOUISVILLE, Ky. (WDRB+WAVE)- Another bright, sunny day with highs generally in the upper 60s to lower 70s with a slight breeze this afternoon. 
 Clear skies tonight with valley/river fog once again possible after the midnight hours. Lows look to range from the upper 30s to upper 40s depending on location. 
 Great weather for Saturday with lots of sunshine and highs in the lower 70s. 
 Mainly clear and cool Saturday night with lows in 40s. 
 High pressure remains in control of our weather through the weekend and into most of next week. The weather may become a bit more active toward Halloween but that is still a long way off yet.
